personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean layout fused with warm 8 Hand-Drawn / Editorial Papyrus tones
personality_one_liner: A warm, boundless, and trustworthy marketplace blending high-impact photography with soft papyrus tones and energetic orange accents.

spacing.rule: Generous Airbnb-style padding; minimal dividing lines. Use whitespace to separate content blocks. Ensure full-bleed images use edge-to-edge layout.

do's: Floating search bar at the top of Discover.
Bottom tab bar over scrolling content.
Sticky 'Book Now' footer on the Tutor Profile.
Floating back buttons over full-bleed hero images.
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism on standard list rows or form fields.

screens.name: Onboarding & Role Selection
screens.purpose: Welcomes users and splits flow between 'I am a Parent' and 'I am a Tutor'.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a heavy dark vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse). Bottom 30% contains the title, a warm greeting, and two pill-shaped buttons stacked vertically (Primary for Parent, Secondary for Tutor). Minimal UI chrome.

screens.name: Discover (Parent Home)
screens.purpose: Allows parents to browse and filter tutors based on languages, ratings, and price.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for cards and horizontal scroll rows.
states.empty: Illustration of a magnifying glass over a papyrus background with 'No tutors found in this language'.
states.error: Error message with 'Tap to retry' button.

screens.layout: Airbnb-style boundless feed. Floating glassmorphism search bar at the top (safe area). Horizontal carousel for 'Languages' (chips). Main feed consists of large, edge-to-edge square photo cards of tutors. Below each photo: Title (Name), Subtitle (Languages), Right-aligned Price & Rating. Minimal borders, using whitespace for separation.

screens.name: Tutor Profile
screens.purpose: Detailed view of the tutor, showing their bio, languages, accreditation, and reviews.

states.loading: Skeleton UI replicating the profile layout.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of the tutor at the top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim and a floating glass Back button. Content below scrolls over the image. Sections include: Quick Stats (horizontal icons for rating, rate, location), 'About me' text, 'Accreditations' (horizontal scrolling small cards/photos), and 'Reviews' (list). A sticky glass footer anchored at the bottom houses the 'Book Session' primary CTA.

screens.name: Booking Flow
screens.purpose: Select dates, time slots, and confirm payment via Stripe.

states.error: Inline error text below the specific failed input.

screens.layout: Clean, single-column form. A custom calendar view for date selection, followed by a segmented control or chip grid for time slots. A summary card details the hourly rate * duration = total. 'Pay with Stripe' mocked UI button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Messages
screens.purpose: In-app chat between parents and tutors.

states.empty: Illustration of a chat bubble on a papyrus background with 'No messages yet'.

screens.layout: Standard inbox list view. Clean rows with round avatar, name, and preview snippet. Inside a chat: distinct bubbles. Parent messages in brandPrimary, Tutor messages in surfaceSecondary.

screens.name: Tutor Dashboard
screens.purpose: Allows tutors to manage availability, upload accreditations, and view upcoming bookings.
screens.layout: Overview screen with 2x2 grid for key metrics (Earnings, Hours). A horizontal scroll for 'Upcoming Bookings'. A dedicated section for 'My Profile' where they can upload new accreditation photos. Uses surfaceSecondary cards on a surface background for slight elevation without heavy shadows.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adopt an Airbnb-style boundless UI: Use generous whitespace and large imagery over harsh borders and drop shadows.
Ensure 'Discover' utilizes a floating search bar wrapped in a glassmorphism container pinned to the top (safe area).
Tutor Profile cards on the Discover page should have large, edge-to-edge images with price and rating immediately below, skipping heavy card containers.
Implement the Papyrus and Orange color palette strictly. Avoid pure whites (#FFFFFF) for the main canvas, defaulting to the warm '#FAF8F5' surface.
Zero tolerance for blue or purple accents; adhere to the warm earthy/orange brand palette.

For all images that have text overlaid (e.g., Onboarding Hero, Tutor Profile header), YOU MUST apply a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim overlay using the surfaceInverse token (from transparent to at least 70% opacity at the bottom) to guarantee text contrast.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for a warm, highly legible, geometric sans-serif feel (mimicking Circular). Only weights 400 and 500.
When building the booking screen, ensure the 'Pay with Stripe' CTA is sticky at the bottom.
